sources.publisher: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission / Mobileye Global Inc.

facts: Mobileye disclosed that effective September 3, 2026, Executive Vice President Business Development & Strategy Nimrod Nehushtan transitioned to a part-time role focused on corporate strategy.
Mobileye disclosed that Vice President of Business Development Nimrod Brickman will continue to lead the company's business development activities after the transition.
The filing states Nehushtan's existing compensation arrangements had not been modified as of the September 10 filing date.

factors.name: governancePower
factors.basis: A senior strategy/business-development role changed while operating business-development leadership remains identified; this is current source-addressed governance/execution evidence but does not by itself establish disruption or improvement.

factors.name: executionMonitoring
factors.basis: The transition creates a concrete leadership continuity item Alpha can monitor against robotaxi, ADAS and physical-AI commercialization milestones without inferring an operational effect not disclosed by the filing.

risks: The filing does not explain the reason for the transition or quantify any effect on customer acquisition, strategic partnerships, commercialization timing or financial performance.
A role transition should not be treated as evidence of execution deterioration or improvement without subsequent operating evidence.
unknowns: Whether the leadership transition changes strategic priorities, partnership cadence or commercial execution is not disclosed.
No successor to the combined EVP Business Development & Strategy title is identified in this filing; business-development leadership continuity is identified separately.
authorityBoundary: Source acquisition only. No numeric underwriting, Earth Score, causal disposition, rank, tick or Chief decision is asserted.
